newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Dismal PLDT net, Dow fall depresses Manila stocks.
newsitem.headline: Dismal PLDT net, Dow fall depresses Manila stocks.

text.p: * Debutant Boulevard ends below offer price
Manila stocks fell anew at the close on Monday as report of a drop in the first quarter profits of PLDT added to the market's property and banking gloom, traders said.
The main index fell below its support of 2,850 to 2,837.31, down 1.22 percent or by 35.06 points in light trade.
"Investors cashed in their investments after the index broke 2,850," said Michael Julian, trader at Philippine Asia Equity.
Julian said most foreign investors were out of the market following Friday's 53-point fall in the Dow Jones.
Some 1.6 billion pesos worth of shares changed hands, with losers trouncing gainers 97 to 24. Prices of 69 other issues were unchanged.
Boulevard Properties Holdings Inc made a lacklustre debut, ending at 81 centavos as against its offer price of one peso. Market leader Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co lost 10 pesos to 1,545.
Traders said the market would closely watch earnings reports of other blue chips on Tuesday. --DOLLY AGLAY (63 2) 841-8936
